ziggs.why: P periodically arms an empowered attack and its own cooldown is cut further by casting any ability. Q's bomb can be aimed to detonate immediately on the target, and R's aim naturally lands the full-damage epicenter on a stationary target, so neither needs a geometry assumption; W is a plain throw-then-detonate recast. E scatters 11 proximity mines with steep falloff after the first, and how many actually contact one stationary target is a real geometry assumption.
